text: {"lessons":["I should avoid panic-selling after sharp losses; I sold Stocks D and E at substantial losses, and should reassess them calmly against my long-term needs.","My account value has fluctuated, so I should prioritize a steady, diversified approach that limits large swings and protects money needed for living expenses.","I have traded infrequently so far; I should continue to make deliberate decisions rather than reacting to every monthly price move."]}
